residency_requirement: Indian resident; treatment in India only
sub_limits_waiting_notes: Hospital Cash benefit under Section II has a 3-day waiting period from admission

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Room rent up to 0.5% of SI/day, ICU up to 1% of SI/day; medical practitioner fees and other expenses up to 15% of SI per any-one-illness each
inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Indemnity cover within overall Section I sum insured of Rs 30,000 or Rs 50,000

day_care_treatments.limit_text: Modern treatments (12 listed procedures) up to 50% of SI per modern procedure

maternity_coverage.limit_text: Up to Rs 2,500 for normal delivery and Rs 5,000 for caesarean/extra-uterine delivery
maternity_coverage.notes: 12-month waiting period; once-in-lifetime per insured; expenses must be in-hospital in India; newborn medical expenses also covered

newborn_coverage.limit_text: Medical expenses for newborn baby (up to 90 days) covered when maternity claim is admitted

ayush_coverage.notes: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered subject to AYUSH Hospital/Day Care Centre definitions

permanent_exclusions: Rest Cure, Rehabilitation and Respite Care (Excl 05)
Spectacles, Contact Lens, Hearing Aid, Cochlear Implants
notable_exclusions_summary: Government-subsidised IRDAI-standardised exclusions plus dental, vision-aids, fertility/sterility, cosmetic, alternative therapies. Treatment outside India is not covered.
claim_process_summary: Cashless via TPA at network hospital: pre-authorisation required (72 hrs prior planned / 24 hrs emergency). Reimbursement: notify TPA/Company 72 hrs before planned admission or within 24 hrs of emergency; submit documents within 30 days of discharge. Settlement offer within 15 days; payment within 7 days of acceptance.
